text.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا

words.gloss_range: sequential or explanatory connector; locally it makes the warning follow and answer the preceding rise

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed saying or warning utterance

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the messenger's speech a response, not a detached new scene. It reaches into the preceding rise and turns it into the occasion for warning, so the reader hears sequence and consequence together. Because it is fused into {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), the boundary and the speech-act open in one clipped movement; the scene moves quickly from threat to voiced warning.

topics.headline: warning follows as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is triggered by the prior rise, so it arrives as a causal-sequential answer rather than free-standing instruction.
topics.reason: The particle is identified as resumptive or sequential, and the clause begins immediately after the prior narrative motion.

topics.headline: connector fused to speech onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the connector and speech verb make one swift opening that shifts the scene from silent motion to prophetic confrontation.
topics.reason: The surface joins the particle to the saying verb, and the Thamud speech-opening formula is supported by parallel warning scenes (7:73, 26:155).

words.gloss_range: completed saying that introduces a direct warning quotation; locally it carries authoritative delivery rather than casual speech
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, declaration, and command-delivery when licensed by content; local perfect verb selects a completed utterance in a prophetic warning frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: to them; lām-marked addressee phrase
accusative warning object

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) is the hinge that turns narration into quoted warning. The verb governs the speech frame, while the quoted content itself begins with the accusative warning object {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}), so the saying delivers command-like alarm without spelling out a separate imperative. Its perfect active form fixes one decisive utterance by the messenger; the same saying-to-them messenger formula marks prophetic confrontation in the Thamud warnings (7:73, 26:155). The next ayah answers that utterance with denial and violation (91:14).

topics.headline: speech verb opens taḥdhīr quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the saying verb introduces direct speech whose force comes through a compressed warning construction.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks words 7-10 as quoted content, and the ellipsis evidence licenses an omitted warning verb inside that quotation.

topics.headline: speaker, addressees, and content stay distinct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar separates the audience from the warning object and keeps the messenger visible as the speaking agent.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَهُمْ}} ({{tr:lahum}}) is the lām-marked addressee phrase, while {{ar:رَسُولُ}} ({{tr:rasūlu}}) is the explicit subject of the active perfect verb.

topics.headline: completed warning moment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a single completed prophetic intervention before the community's response, not an ongoing background exhortation.
topics.reason: The local form is a perfect active third masculine singular verb, and the frame has a clausal quoted object.

topics.headline: formulaic confrontation answered by denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the utterance as part of a recurring Thamud warning scene and as the speech-act immediately reversed by denial in the next ayah.
topics.reason: The parallel formula appears in Thamud warning narratives (7:73, 26:155), and 91:14 directly responds to the messenger's speech with denial.

words.gloss_range: prepositional lām governing the plural pronoun; locally it marks the warned community as speech recipients and potential violators

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: third masculine plural pronoun for the addressed group
completed saying that introduces the warning quotation

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) turns the following pronoun into the addressee complement of {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}). That keeps the community in the recipient role, not as the speaker and not as the object protected in the quotation. Because the phrase comes before the messenger title, the target audience is heard first, and the warning is directed to them with pressure as possible violators.

topics.headline: lām marks the recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Thamud are grammatically the recipients of the warning, not its speaker or protected object.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the pronoun governed by lām as the complement of the saying verb.

topics.headline: recipient force also carries warning pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the warning as speech delivered to them and bearing against them because they are the potential violators.
topics.reason: The local grammar selects addressee marking; the directed-against nuance survives as contextual pressure from the warning frame, not as a separate syntactic role.

words.gloss_range: third masculine plural pronoun; locally the previously named Thamud recast as accountable addressees
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) compresses Thamud into a bound plural pronoun while keeping the earlier narrative in view. The form shifts the collective from the group out of which the wrongdoer rose into the audience directly warned. Its smallness also matters: the addressees are brief, while the protected sign and her watering receive fuller naming.

topics.headline: Thamud become accountable addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same collective from the prior scene is now placed before the messenger as the warned audience.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence links the pronoun to the earlier Thamud mention, while the lām phrase gives the group addressee status.

topics.headline: pronoun is audience, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protected object has not appeared yet; the plural group is only the audience receiving the warning.
topics.reason: The pronoun belongs to the prepositional complement before the quoted warning content begins at word 7.

topics.headline: small pronoun contrasts with expanded sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural weight shift: the community is compact, while the she-camel and her watering are fully foregrounded.
topics.reason: The addressee group is represented by a short attached pronoun, whereas the quote expands the warned object as a construct phrase plus coordinated watering right.

words.gloss_range: messenger, commissioned envoy, or sent message-bearer; locally the delayed nominative subject whose office carries divine authorization
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatching, message-bearing, and controlled release; local noun selects the commissioned messenger office rather than a finite act of sending

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive divine name completing the messenger construct

words.prose: {{ar:رَسُولُ}} ({{tr:rasūlu}}) arrives after the addressees but remains the nominative subject of the saying. The delay lets the audience be heard first, then identifies the voice by office rather than by the prophet's personal name. In construct with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), the title makes the utterance a commissioned delivery; the dispatch field of the root supports that pressure while the local noun keeps the focus on the messenger standing in the scene. That sent-channel pressure counters the self-emerging wrongdoer, and the title supplies the authority whose warning is denied and whose protected object is violated in 91:14.

topics.headline: delayed subject remains speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger is delayed in word order but not demoted in agency.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative and attachment evidence identifies it as the subject of the saying verb.

topics.headline: office foregrounds divine commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning depends on the sender-authorized office, not on personal biography.
topics.reason: The construct phrase makes the noun definite by divine attribution, and the ayah names the title rather than Salih.

topics.headline: sent channel, not private opinion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the messenger as a divinely dispatched counter-presence to the self-emerging wrongdoer.
topics.reason: The root field supports sending and dispatch, but the local form is the noun of office, so release or animal-management senses remain image pressure rather than selected local senses.

topics.headline: title bridges denial and violation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the title as the named authority whose warning is denied and whose protected object is violated in the next ayah.
topics.reason: The recurring speech frame compresses the Thamud confrontation, and the title supplies the referent for the denied-him pronoun in 91:14 while also echoing the denial setup in 91:11.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive construct; locally it authorizes the messenger as belonging to or sent by God
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with documented derivational dispute; locally the proper name and genitive construct relation, not etymology alone, carry the force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: messenger as construct head
second divine-name genitive attached to the she-camel
messenger of God construct phrase

words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes the messenger construct. Its genitive case keeps the divine name inside {{ar:رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:rasūlu Allāhi}}), so God is the source of the speaker's authority while the messenger remains the overt subject who speaks. This first divine genitive also prepares the second one with the she-camel, forming a double ownership frame across the warning.

topics.headline: genitive authorizes the messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speaker's authority is grammatically sourced in the divine name while the messenger remains the human channel.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the dependent of the messenger construct, not the subject of the saying verb.

topics.headline: root dispute subordinated to proper-name force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that derivational background does not replace the local mechanism: a unique proper divine name authorizes the messenger through construct grammar.
topics.reason: The documented derivational dispute is valid background, but local syntax selects the proper divine name in genitive position as the operative feature.

topics.headline: first divine genitive prepares the second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine name first authorizes the warner and then marks the protected sign.
topics.reason: The ayah contains two genitive divine-name constructs, one with the messenger and one with the she-camel, creating a paired authority frame.

words.gloss_range: the she-camel as an accusative warning object; locally a concrete Thamud sign-creature marked by divine ownership and linked to her watering right
words.root_gloss_range: Quranically narrow root field centered on the Thamud she-camel as a concrete animal and sign; broader camel-handling derivatives are not locally selected

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive divine name marking ownership
her assigned watering
God's she-camel as a construct phrase

words.prose: {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}) is the first word of the quoted warning, and its accusative case lets the object itself carry the alarm. The accepted nominative contrast shows how much force the case carries: the local reading is command-like warning, not merely declaration. As {{ar:نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:nāqata Allāhi}}), the animal is not generic livestock but a concrete divine sign; she is still a living, resource-bearing creature whose feminine form can bind the later {{ar:سُقْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:suqyāhā}}). The rare root distribution keeps the focus on the Thamud she-camel, and 91:14 immediately turns the warned object into the harmed object.

topics.headline: accusative object carries the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quote begins with the protected object itself, making the warning abrupt and performative.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative in a quoted warning span, and the bundle licenses an omitted warning verb.

topics.headline: case variant clarifies speech-act force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case alone can shift the utterance from alarm-like warning toward statement-like designation.
topics.reason: The nominative reading is valid contrast evidence, but the local aligned surface is accusative and therefore keeps the warning construction primary.

topics.headline: divine ownership makes the animal sacrosanct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the animal as a concrete sign-creature under divine ownership, not as ordinary property.
topics.reason: The construct with the divine name defines the she-camel, and the phrase recurs in expanded Thamud warnings (7:73, 11:64).

topics.headline: rare noun field stays narrative-specific
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root does not spread into a general camel vocabulary here; it concentrates on the Thamud sign.
topics.reason: The occurrence evidence confines the Quranic distribution to noun uses for the Thamud she-camel, while broader camel-handling derivatives remain outside the local form.

topics.headline: living resource links to her watering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sign as an embodied creature whose feminine form and social-resource setting prepare the attached watering right.
topics.reason: The word is feminine singular, allowing the later suffix to refer back to the she-camel, and the lexical field remains concretely pastoral.

topics.headline: warning object becomes violated object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same she-camel named in warning becomes the object of harm in 91:14.
topics.reason: The feminine object named here is resumed by the next ayah's feminine object pronoun in the hamstringing report (91:14).

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive construct; locally it marks the she-camel as God's property and sign
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with documented derivational dispute; locally the proper name in construct marks ownership and sacred status

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head: the she-camel
first divine-name genitive attached to the messenger
God's she-camel as a construct phrase
messenger of God as a construct phrase

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes {{ar:نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:nāqata Allāhi}}). Its genitive case keeps the divine name inside the she-camel phrase, so the animal's protected status is carried by construct grammar rather than by a separate explanation. The repetition of the same divine genitive after {{ar:رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:rasūlu Allāhi}}) aligns the speaker and the sign under one authority, so rejecting the messenger and harming the camel target the same source.

topics.headline: genitive marks sacred ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the animal is sacrosanct because the construct phrase marks it as God's property and sign.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive as the dependent of the she-camel construct and therefore defines the animal's status.

topics.headline: proper name fixes unique ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that derivational background is subordinate to the local fact that a unique proper divine name marks ownership.
topics.reason: The root-dispute evidence remains background, while local grammar uses the proper name in genitive position to mark non-human ownership.

topics.headline: messenger and camel share one genitive frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rejecting the messenger and harming the camel target the same divine authority.
topics.reason: The same genitive divine name defines both the messenger and the she-camel, creating a paired ownership frame across the ayah.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction; locally it binds the she-camel and her watering under one warning while preserving their distinction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: her watering or assigned watering right
the she-camel as first protected object

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps {{ar:سُقْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:suqyāhā}}) inside the same warning unit as {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}). The conjunction prevents the watering phrase from becoming a new clause and also prevents it from collapsing into mere apposition: animal and watering remain distinct but inseparable protected terms. Because it opens the final phrase, the connector carries the warning into its closing sound.

topics.headline: watering stays under the same warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the watering phrase is coordinated under the same warning governance, not introduced as a fresh statement.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates the watering noun with the she-camel inside the quoted warning content.

topics.headline: distinct terms form one protected unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the animal and her water access cannot be separated without weakening the warning.
topics.reason: The conjunction binds two protected objects under one warning while preserving the distinction between creature and right.

topics.headline: connector launches the closing phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addition of the watering right is immediate and becomes the audible close of the warning.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic to the following phrase in the recited surface, so the addition arrives without delay and leads into the final long-vowel ending.

words.gloss_range: her watering, watering-turn, or assigned water access; locally a nominalized protected right attached to the she-camel
words.root_gloss_range: watering, giving water, providing water, seeking water, and water-access arrangements; local noun with suffix selects an assigned watering event or right, not water as substance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the she-camel, antecedent of the feminine suffix
coordinating conjunction joining the watering to the she-camel

words.prose: {{ar:سُقْيَاهَا}} ({{tr:suqyāhā}}) closes the warning on the she-camel's assigned water access. The feminine suffix points back to {{ar:نَاقَةَ}} ({{tr:nāqata}}), not to the plural addressees, so the right is hers and cannot be redefined as theirs. The noun names a watering act, turn, or entitlement rather than water as a substance; coordinated with the she-camel, it becomes a protected object inside the same warning. Because this water access is spoken by God's messenger under divine ownership grammar, resource allocation becomes a moral test rather than mundane logistics. Its final position makes the resource-allocation issue the last audible element before 91:14 narrates denial and harm.

topics.headline: suffix assigns the watering to her
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the water access belongs specifically to the she-camel, not to the community.
topics.reason: The suffix is third feminine singular and attachment evidence links it to the she-camel phrase, while the addressees are masculine plural.

topics.headline: watering shares accusative warning governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the watering right stands beside the she-camel as part of one protected sign-and-access arrangement.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the watering noun with the accusative warning object inside the quote, and the suffix binds it back to the she-camel.

topics.headline: noun names water access, not mere water
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning protects an allocated watering act or turn, not just physical water.
topics.reason: The local form is a nominal watering term with possessive suffix; broader water-provision or seeking-water derivatives support the allocation field but do not replace the selected noun.

topics.headline: marked form centers the entitlement itself
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording objectifies the act of watering as a protected share rather than narrating an agent giving water.
topics.reason: The exact noun form is marked in the bundle, and the nominal construction centers the entitlement rather than a finite water-giving action.

topics.headline: water provision becomes a moral test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the water-right as a moral test embedded in prophetic speech and divine ownership, not mundane logistics.
topics.reason: The broader water-provision field supplies parallels for water as a test, including Midian watering and guest provision scenes (28:24-25, 51:27), while the local noun keeps the focus on the she-camel's assigned access.

topics.headline: final word anticipates violation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the protected entitlement before the next ayah answers with denial, harm, and sin.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah with the feminine suffix that will be answered by the same feminine object chain in 91:14, and its long final cadence binds it to the surrounding sequence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compressed pair نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا joins the she-camel to her watering, while the divine name recurs in رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ and نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An authorized, articulated message places a living creature and her allocated access to water inside one announced divine boundary. The warning protects not only an animal as property but the life-support entitlement attached to her.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the public speech-act that makes the protected boundary audible.
Messenger and carried message make the speaker's authority inseparable from the warning he transmits.
The fixed divine name makes the two genitives a repeated seal over messenger and camel.
The literal she-camel supplies the vulnerable living bearer of the protected claim.
An irrigation share and its channel turn watering into an apportioned right rather than an incidental drink.

changed_reading.before: The messenger mentions God's she-camel and tells the people to allow her to drink.
changed_reading.after: The utterance establishes one protected life-support unit: violating either the she-camel or her allocated water-access violates the announced divine charge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive هَا in سُقْيَاهَا assigns watering to the camel, and the whole pair is placed after an address to لَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of earnest concern, deliberate conduct, animal management, and provision shift the sentence from a negative taboo to a positive duty of stewardship. The hearers must actively make the shared setting workable for the animal.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern makes the saying an act of committed care for what is named.
Gentleness and deliberate pace supply a non-impulsive mode for administering the warning.
Taming, training, and managing make the camel a charge requiring competent social handling.
Providing a watering source supplies the positive obligation to preserve access, not merely to refrain from harm.

changed_reading.before: Keep away from a sacred camel and do not obstruct one episode of drinking.
changed_reading.after: Accept an ongoing stewardship duty: manage conduct and shared water so the divinely assigned animal can actually receive her provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal سُقْيَاهَا can denote a standing water-share, and its coordination with the camel makes the share part of her continuing social position.
baseline_models.mechanism: Succession and following branches activate a schedule rather than a one-time event. The warning protects recurrence: the camel must arrive in her turn, and the community must let the sequence continue.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches supplies an ordered procession of users or turns.
The literal she-camel identifies the participant whose place in the sequence is at issue.
The irrigation-share branch supplies the recurring allotment that needs an order.
The non-dominant mapped branch of following one after another gives the allotment a procession-like temporal form.

changed_reading.before: Let the camel take a drink.
changed_reading.after: Preserve the camel's recurrent turn in a shared sequence; the protected object is a schedule as much as a quantity of water.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse places the messenger's saying immediately beside the concrete camel-and-water arrangement.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch in which a thing's 'saying' is its indication allows the animal's visible treatment to carry the message after the messenger speaks. The community answers the speech by what it lets the camel's body do at the water.

activation_trace.role: A thing's indication as its saying lets material conduct become legible speech.
Messenger and message establish the verbal transmission that the material arrangement can enact.
The camel's visible body supplies the sign-bearing participant.
Actual giving of drink makes compliance or refusal publicly observable.

changed_reading.before: The message consists in the messenger's words.
changed_reading.after: The words install an embodied message: the camel's unhindered drinking, or its obstruction, visibly states the community's answer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَسُول, نَاقَة, and سُقْيَا place transmission, livestock, and incoming water in one compact construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger root's branch of milk and continuous yield activates a metabolic circuit around the camel: water enters a living animal and sustaining yield can flow outward. Protection concerns continuity of exchange, not possession of an inert object.

activation_trace.role: Milk and continuous animal yield supply the outward-flowing side of a reciprocal resource circuit.
The she-camel supplies the living converter between incoming water and possible outward yield.
Giving drink supplies the necessary inflow that keeps the living circuit open.
Earnest concern makes continuity of the circuit the object of the messenger's care.

changed_reading.before: Water is a resource consumed by the camel.
changed_reading.after: Watering sustains a reciprocal living flow; the warning opposes an extractive order that wants yield while severing the creature's required inflow.

context_deltas.mechanism: Extension, following, disclosure, and covering form an alternation of timed relations before the focus. They strengthen the baseline water-share into a turn nested within an ordered cycle: a rightful participant appears, receives its interval, and yields to what follows.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the apportioned water-share whose temporal form is being revised.
Succession in batches supplies a focus-local seed for recurrent turns.
Daylight's extension supplies an interval that opens and occupies time.
Following and succession make one participant's place depend on ordered relation to another.
Disclosure gives each turn a phase of public appearance rather than secret possession.
A covering that succeeds disclosure supplies closure and handoff to the cycle.

structural_cues: 91:1-4 repeatedly pair an entity with what it does to هَا, producing ordered relational clauses before سُقْيَاهَا.
The focus coordinates the camel and her watering instead of presenting water as an incidental circumstance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of extended light, following, disclosure, and covering; I infer that this alternation models turn-taking for the focus water-share. A live alternative is that the cosmic sequence supplies scale and regularity without specifying a social schedule.

changed_reading.before: The camel has a recurrent but locally negotiated turn at water.
changed_reading.after: Her turn participates in the same kind of ordered alternation displayed by the cosmic sequence; blocking it is an attempt to monopolize a cycle that works through succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building by joining parts and spreading a traversable ground recast the water allotment as habitat architecture. The camel's share is not a detachable favor: it is one relation whose removal makes the inhabited order fail its own construction.

activation_trace.role: Animal management supplies the concrete stewardship problem inside the habitat.
The irrigation share supplies the load-bearing allocation within the shared setting.
Construction by joining parts supplies the model of an order held together by relations.
Spreading and extending supplies the common ground across which the managed allocation operates.

structural_cues: The heaven/building and earth/spreading pairs move from enclosing structure to usable ground.
The focus places a mobile animal and a water arrangement inside that already ordered habitat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly and spatial extension; I infer that a just habitat depends on preserving the camel-water relation as one of its joined parts. A live alternative is that these roots describe creation generally and do not directly govern resource access.

changed_reading.before: The people owe care to a specially designated animal.
changed_reading.after: Their obligation tests whether their built and spread habitat can include a nonhuman claimant; the water-share functions as civic infrastructure, not private indulgence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The living self and the repeated act of making even bring the camel's embodied need into the surah's balance language. The same root that accompanies the self's formation later accompanies the aftermath, so the focus becomes an offered equilibrium whose rejection returns as a harsher equalization.

activation_trace.role: The literal animal anchors the reading in an embodied other rather than an abstract moral theme.
An apportioned share supplies the practical measure by which balance can include that other.
The life-bearing self supplies a category in which bodily dependence matters morally.
Equality and commensuration supply the offered ordering of competing claims.
The repeated equality branch makes the later outcome a severe return of the same ordering vocabulary.

structural_cues: سَوَّاهَا occurs with the self in 91:7 and returns as سَوَّاهَا after the community's action in 91:14.
The focus's two divine genitives place the nonhuman claimant inside, rather than outside, the charged order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a living self, commensuration, and a later repetition of the same verb; I infer an offered balance that can reverse into punitive leveling when the share is destroyed. A live alternative is that the two occurrences of س و ي have distinct local senses with no reversal between them.

changed_reading.before: The water-share is a rule imposed on a community for one sacred animal.
changed_reading.after: The rule asks whether communal balance can recognize another embodied self; refusal converts a gentle proportional measure into an indiscriminate equalization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ingestion, rupture, and protective self-placement turn the messenger's external words into a concrete form of the inward fork. Respecting the water boundary performs protection; breaking through it performs rupture. The camel makes an otherwise interior distinction materially decidable.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the external statement that can be received or resisted.
The bounded water-share supplies the concrete line across which either restraint or rupture is enacted.
Swallowing and taking something fully inside supply a material image for inward reception.
Deviation and breaching a cover supply the destructive option of crossing the announced limit.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the alternative of restraint around the vulnerable claim.

structural_cues: 91:8 coordinates two opposed possessive terms, while 91:13 coordinates the camel and her possessive water-share.
The focus addresses a plural audience, converting inward capacity into a collective public choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward taking, breach, and protection; I infer that the messenger's water rule externalizes those moral alternatives into one observable choice. A live alternative is that 91:8 remains a general anthropology and does not map one-to-one onto the camel episode.

changed_reading.before: The warning conveys an externally imposed prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The warning gives the audience a material fork: preserve a boundary and enact protection, or pierce it and enact the rupture already available within the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ploughing, growth, and hidden insertion activate an ecological and psychic reading of the water-share. Shared water can cultivate life, but a community can also bury the claim that constrains its own land use. The camel becomes a rival claimant through whom cultivation is distinguished from concealed extraction.

activation_trace.role: The irrigation share supplies the contested ecological resource linking land, growth, and animal life.
The farmer who cuts the earth supplies the productive land-use pressure around shared water.
Growth and increase supply the life-enhancing result that proper watering can serve.
Secret insertion or burial supplies the contrary move of suppressing an inconvenient claim.

structural_cues: 91:9-10 form a success/failure and cultivation/burial antithesis.
The focus names an animal together with a resource also used for cultivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies farming, growth, concealment, and an irrigation share; I infer a conflict between inclusive cultivation and monopolizing land-water use. A live alternative is that the cultivation imagery is solely moral and does not imply an economic resource conflict.

changed_reading.before: The people are asked to preserve an exceptional animal's access to water.
changed_reading.after: The request tests their model of prosperity: genuine cultivation makes room for another life, whereas apparent gain buries the limiting claim that exposes extraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attribution to falsehood removes the warning's truth-status, while the split transgression inventory supplies both crossing a limit and water rising beyond bounds. Because the focus boundary is itself a water allotment, moral transgression and hydraulic overflow become structurally homologous.

activation_trace.role: The messenger's articulated saying supplies the truth-claim that the group can reject.
A water-share and channel supply the bounded flow whose limit must hold.
Attributing a speaker or thing to falsehood supplies the discursive removal of the boundary's authority.
Exceeding a limit in disobedience supplies the social form of transgression.
Water overflowing its bound supplies the material analogue that makes violation of a water-share especially charged.

structural_cues: 91:11 names denial and transgression immediately before the actor rises and the warning is quoted.
The focus names a delimited water relation rather than water in the abstract.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falsehood-attribution, limit-crossing, and overflowing water; I infer that rejecting the utterance lets appetite exceed the channel assigned to it. A live alternative is that the water-overflow branch is only a general metaphor for excess and does not specifically reactivate سُقْيَاهَا.

changed_reading.before: Transgression explains why the people ignore a water rule.
changed_reading.after: Their transgression takes the rule's own material form: they first deny the boundary and then overflow the share, turning a managed current into unbounded appropriation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sent messenger and the roused, struggling wrongdoer become opposed vectors. The saying is an interceptive act inserted into motion: authorized dispatch seeks to slow and redirect a destructive self-launch before it reaches the camel.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the authorized vector embodied by the messenger.
Articulated speech supplies the braking intervention made within the unfolding action.
Rousing what was still supplies the antagonist's abrupt launch into action.
Struggling through hardship supplies the actor's grim persistence once mobilized.

structural_cues: 91:12 presents an inceptive movement, and 91:13 answers it with the messenger's speech.
Both ر س ل and ب ع ث carry dispatch or activation images, but their agents and ends diverge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized sending, rousing, and hard persistence; I infer two opposed trajectories and read the utterance as an attempted interception. A live alternative is that انبعث merely reports spontaneous action and does not mirror the messenger's dispatch.

changed_reading.before: The messenger states a standing prohibition.
changed_reading.after: The saying is a last directional intervention: one dispatched figure uses speech to arrest the destructive trajectory of another activated figure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from repudiating the message to cutting the animal's legs. It confirms that the focus pair protects an organism together with its sustaining access: discursive denial clears the way for an attack on the bodily carrier of the water claim.

activation_trace.role: The literal she-camel supplies the body named in the protected pair.
Giving drink supplies the bodily support process coordinated with the animal.
Attributing the messenger to falsehood supplies the discursive act that deauthorizes his protection.
Cutting an animal's legs supplies the literal destruction of its mobility and bodily support.

structural_cues: 91:14 chains repudiation and hamstringing with successive فَ particles.
The focus had already coordinated the animal and the process that sustains her.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repudiation and leg-cutting, while the focus supplies camel plus watering; I infer that the pair anticipates inseparable attacks on body and support-system. A live alternative is that سُقْيَاهَا remains a separate scheduling rule not directly targeted by the hamstringing.

changed_reading.before: The warning protects two adjacent items, the camel and her watering.
changed_reading.after: It names an integrated vulnerability in advance: once the message is denied, the body that bears the claim is disabled and its access to sustaining flow is rendered impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Nurturing completion, extirpation, and equalization create a severe reversal around the repeated divine relation. The focus's protected provision can be read as maintenance offered by the divine owner; after its rejection, the same ordering power no longer maintains differentiated shares but levels the order that destroyed them.

activation_trace.role: The repeated fixed divine name supplies the ownership relation that links warning and consequence.
Provision of a watering source supplies the maintenance mode offered in the focus.
Extirpation supplies the terminal mode that replaces failed maintenance.
Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship legible first as ordering care rather than mere domination.
Equalization supplies the reversal from differentiated allotment to a flattened outcome.

structural_cues: The focus repeats the divine name around messenger and camel; 91:14 resumes the relation with رَبُّهُمْ.
Provision in 91:13 is followed by a chain ending in سَوَّاهَا in 91:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, nurturing order, extirpation, and equalization; I infer a reversal from maintained differentiation to terminal leveling. A live alternative is that divine nurture and destruction are juxtaposed but do not form one maintenance-failure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The divine ownership makes infringement sacrilegious and punishment follows.
changed_reading.after: Divine ownership first appears as maintenance of a vulnerable share; punishment is the catastrophic reversal in which the order that refused measured provision loses its own differentiated stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tail, anticipated harm, and aftermath turn the focus speech into a prospective causal break-point. The messenger names the vulnerable relation before the action so that the hearers can prevent the tail of consequences; the later outcome is not external to the warning but what the warning was trying to interrupt.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the timely intervention before consequence becomes irreversible.
The water-share supplies the small present boundary at which the future chain can still be stopped.
The tail or end of a thing supplies a consequence that trails the initiating act.
Fear as anticipation of harm supplies the prospective stance available to the human audience.
The end and aftermath of a thing supply the terminal state already latent in the warned-against act.

structural_cues: The focus is direct speech placed before 91:14's rapid causal chain.
91:15 closes on the outcome or aftermath, making temporal consequence explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trailing end, anticipation of harm, and aftermath; I infer that the warning is designed as the last preventable node in that chain. A live alternative is that these later roots only describe retrospective judgment and do not alter the force of the earlier utterance.

changed_reading.before: The messenger announces a prohibition whose violation will later be punished.
changed_reading.after: He exposes the causal hinge while choice remains: preserving one bounded water relation averts the long tail, whereas crossing it releases an aftermath no later deliberation can recall.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ق ي to س و ق mapping and an anatomically distant branch. It remains valid as a branch-backed resonance anchored in سُقْيَاهَا and sharpened by later leg-cutting and heel/trace imagery. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant support network, not claim that سُقْيَا lexically means leg.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سُقْيَاهَا is explicitly coordinated with the camel, and its split inventory contains the animal shank or supporting stem.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant shank and supporting-stem branch overlays watering with the structure that carries a body.
The literal she-camel supplies the body whose support and movement are at stake.
Cutting the animal's legs realizes the destruction of bodily support.
Heel and trace extend the support image into what remains behind after movement is stopped.

changed_reading.before: Watering sustains the camel from outside.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant anatomy gathers around the phrase: external flow and bodily support are one vulnerability, later cut at the legs and preserved only as an aftermath-trace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus watering noun activates an idiom of making a heart drink repeated hostility. It remains anchored in the same focus root and in the messenger's explicit saying, while swallowing and denial in context make reception consequential. Downstream prose should present this as rhetorical enactment alongside literal watering, not replace the animal's water-share with an idiomatic gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ and سُقْيَاهَا place speech and watering in the same short utterance.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies what is being pressed upon the audience for reception.
Making a heart drink what it dislikes turns the water warning into an unwelcome verbal dose.
Swallowing something fully supplies the inward path by which the spoken limit could be received.
Attributing the message to falsehood supplies the refusal to ingest or retain the unwelcome command.

changed_reading.before: The messenger verbally commands them to permit literal watering.
changed_reading.after: His saying also performs a figurative watering of the hearers: it makes them take in a disliked limit, and their denial is a refusal of that inward draught before they deny the camel's literal one.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries ذَنْب from moral fault into the packet's watercourse-tail branch. It remains anchored in the focus's irrigation share and in the later explicit ذَنْب and aftermath vocabulary. Downstream prose should mark it as a hydraulic analogy for causal consequence, not assert that the verse's ذَنْب simply means a water channel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's سُقْيَاهَا can be an irrigation share and channel whose downstream effects depend on respecting its bounds.

activation_trace.role: The irrigation share and channel supply the upstream allocation from which consequences can flow.
Watercourse tails and valley ends give the fault a spatially downstream image.
A remnant and trace supply what the initiating violation leaves behind.

changed_reading.before: Their sin causes a later punishment.
changed_reading.after: The violated water boundary generates its own downstream tail: guilt and aftermath appear as the channel-end and residue of the first act of appropriation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it begins with the non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping, where قَالَ gains a remote large-jar branch, and then joins draught and full-bucket images. It remains packet-backed and anchored by the explicit water-share. Downstream prose should describe a split-root volumetric resonance, never an etymological claim that قَالَ denotes a jar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The spoken formula contains both قَالَ, whose split inventory includes a large water vessel, and سُقْيَاهَا, whose dominant inventory includes an apportioned irrigation share.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant large water-jar branch gives the utterance a remote volumetric container image.
The irrigation share supplies the actual measured entitlement that controls the vessel network.
A draught or portion of drink supplies the small embodied unit of consumption.
A full bucket supplies the drawn and bounded quantity at the far end of the sequence.

changed_reading.before: The warning concerns whether the camel may approach water.
changed_reading.after: A remote vessel-and-portion network asks whether access also entails measurable volume: jar, draught, share, and full bucket shadow the politics of how much each claimant receives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a messenger-root branch contributes milk and continuous animal yield to a verse about a messenger. It remains anchored in رَسُول, the explicit she-camel, and her literal watering, then gains support from growth and nurture branches. Downstream prose should call it a cross-domain flow activation, not redefine رَسُول as milk.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the messenger-root, a she-camel, and giving drink in one sequence, allowing transmission and animal flow to overlap.

activation_trace.role: Milk and continuous livestock yield supply the outward flow enabled by care of the animal.
The literal she-camel supplies the living middle of the input-output circuit.
Giving drink supplies the incoming flow without which the living yield cannot continue.
Growth and increase supply the generative effect of maintaining the circuit.
Feeding and development supply the nurturing process that connects inflow to living increase.

changed_reading.before: The camel consumes a scarce communal resource.
changed_reading.after: The camel is a living circulation point: water received can become growth and yield, so severing her access destroys reciprocity and reveals a community seeking output without sustaining input.

strongest_changes: The camel's watering changes from a one-time drink into a protected, recurrent share whose turn is strengthened by the ordered cosmic alternation.
The external warning becomes a material moral fork: preserving the bounded flow enacts protection, while denying and overflowing it enacts rupture and transgression.
The camel-and-watering pair becomes an integrated life-support unit; later repudiation and leg-cutting show an attack on both bodily carrier and sustaining access.
The speech becomes prospective rather than merely punitive: it marks the last small boundary at which the long tail of aftermath can still be interrupted.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact double divine attribution and camel-water coordination act as a hinge where cosmic succession, habitat design, another living self, moral restraint, resource allocation, and bodily violence remain simultaneously legible. Split mappings also preserve stranger support-anatomy, forced-ingestion, vessel, and reciprocal-flow readings without promoting them to lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which the compressed accusative pair itself encodes an explicit warning rather than relying on an elided construction remains grammatically underdetermined in the packet.
The cosmic sequence strongly supplies regular succession, but its use as a model for a literal water schedule remains an abductive transfer.
The two س و ي occurrences may form an offered-balance-to-leveling reversal, or they may carry locally distinct senses without that causal hinge.
All readings built from non-dominant mapped roots are deliberately form-distant resonances and should not be rendered as direct etymologies or replacements for the surface words.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Messenger speech as boundary-setting utterance.** Lexical evidence: ق و ل B001 "uttered speech"; ر س ل B002 "messenger and message"; ء ل ه B002 fixed Allah-name; و ق ي B001/B002 protection/caution in 91:8. Structural cue: the messenger's saying appears between the roused wretched one and the hamstringing. Assigned role: the utterance installs a protective boundary around "she-camel of Allah" and "her watering." Abductive move: I infer that the elliptical phrase functions as warning/preservation; the packet supplies speech, messenger, divine attribution, and protective root nearby. Reading change: the ayah reads less as bare quotation and more as a verbal fence drawn around a creature and its water-right.

2. **The she-camel as elevated, selected sign.** Lexical evidence: ن و ق B002 "she-camel and its shape"; ن و ق B001 "elevation and height"; ن و ق B006 "choosing or selecting"; ء ل ه B002 "Allah as fixed name." Structural cue: the noun is directly annexed to Allah, paralleling `رسول الله`. Assigned role: ناقة is not generic livestock but an elevated/selected creature marked by divine belonging. Abductive move: I infer that genitive attribution turns her into a sign with inviolable status; the packet supplies she-camel, elevation/selection, and divine name. Reading change: "naqat Allah" becomes a protected selected presence, so harming her is rebellion against the ordering name, not property damage.

3. **Watering as social right and ecological share.** Lexical evidence: س ق ي B001 "giving drink"; B002 "providing a watering source"; B003 "irrigation share and channel"; ذ ن ب B006 "portion or allotted share" in 91:14. Structural cue: `وسقياها` is paired with the she-camel, then their sin/consequence follows. Assigned role: watering is the material right attached to the protected creature. Abductive move: I infer that the conflict is over allocation and access, not merely belief; the packet supplies watering-source/share and later sin/share language. Reading change: the ayah becomes a command about respecting a divinely assigned ecological/social share.

4. **Speech as public report against circulating falsehood.** Lexical evidence: ق و ل B007 "circulating talk or public report"; ك ذ ب B001/B002 falsehood/declaring false in 91:11 and 91:14; ق و ل B014 "thing's saying as indication." Structural cue: the messenger's قول is surrounded by takdhib. Assigned role: true speech and sign-indication confront false public talk. Abductive move: I infer that the she-camel herself "says" something as signification while the messenger verbalizes it; the packet supplies saying, indication, and repeated denial. Reading change: the ayah reads as a layered communication event: word plus sign plus public counter-speech.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:14 made the messenger's clipped saying heavier: `ناقة الله وسقياها` functions as a boundary whose violation is immediately narrated. 91:15 then made the speech legally final in retrospect: their denial challenges the messenger's public word, but the Lord's aftermath admits no follow-up challenge.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Speech as notice of a protected resource relation.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ق و ل/B001` is articulated speech, fixed `ر س ل/B002` is messenger and carried message, and fixed `س ق ي/B003` is an irrigation share or channel. **Structural cue and role:** `قال لهم` introduces the compressed nominal pair `ناقة الله وسقياها`; the possessive suffix gives watering an attached entitlement, so the utterance functions as boundary notice. **Abductive move:** words, messenger, animal, and water share are supplied; taking the ellipsis as warning or injunction is the inferred performative force. **Reading change:** the saying does not merely identify an animal; it publicly establishes a protected allocation.

2. **A message that safeguards continuous yield.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ر س ل/B006` is milk and flowing yield, fixed `ن و ق/B002` is the she-camel, and fixed `س ق ي/B001` is giving drink. **Structural cue and role:** messenger, she-camel, and watering occur in one compact utterance, while denial and hamstringing follow; the dormant milk branch makes the message the carrier of a life-sustaining flow. **Abductive move:** the lexical materials are supplied, but inferring milk or wider provision as the protected yield is material analogy, not an explicit statement. **Reading change:** the messenger carries a resource-preservation claim as well as verbal content.

3. **A test of management rather than domination.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ن و ق/B004` is taming, training, and setting affairs right; fixed `س ق ي/B002` is providing access to a water source. **Structural cue and role:** a bounded animal-water arrangement is placed before the collective's disabling act, so management means maintaining access and restraint rather than mastering by injury. **Abductive move:** the arrangement and later violation are explicit; construing them as a governance test is inferred. **Reading change:** `ناقة الله وسقياها` becomes a compact social order whose success depends on disciplined stewardship.

4. **Legitimate elevation opposed to false ascent.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ن و ق/B001` carries elevation and the mountain's highest point; the she-camel is twice enclosed by the divine name through fixed `ء ل ه/B002`. **Structural cue and role:** 91:11-12 activate transgressive high ground and a rising superlative, whereas this ayah elevates the animal by attributed ownership before 91:14 levels the violators. **Abductive move:** status elevation is inferred from the root branch and genitive framing; no physical ascent of the animal is stated. **Reading change:** the protected she-camel occupies the legitimate high claim against the group's counterfeit prominence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:14 reveals that the compressed utterance was consequential notice: denying the messenger and hamstringing the animal violate its two named poles. The rapid *fa-* chain also sharpens the contrast between `ر س ل/B004` deliberate restraint and domination by impulsive injury.

baseline.text: Bunun üzerine Allah'ın elçisi onlara, "Allah'ın devesine ve onun su içme hakkına dokunmayın!" dedi.

findings.text: Elçinin kısa sözü, deve ile ona ayrılan su payının çevresine kamusal ve koruyucu bir sınır çizen bağlayıcı bir bildirimdir.
Devenin Allah'a ait diye belirlenmesi, onu sıradan bir maldan ayırıp seçilmiş ve dokunulmaz bir işaret konumuna yükseltir.
Elçinin bildirisi, su verilen canlının süt ve diğer yararlarının kesintisiz sürmesini koruyan bir yaşam düzenini de taşır.
Deveyi gözetip işleri yoluna koyma görevi, bu düzeni yaralayarak egemen olmak yerine suya erişimi ölçülü biçimde yöneten bir sorumluluk sınavına dönüşür.
Elçinin kamusal sözü ile devenin işaret oluşu birlikte, topluluğun dolaşıma soktuğu yalanlamaya hem sözlü hem görünür bir karşı bildirim oluşturur.
Devenin yüksekliği, azgın topluluğun sahte yükselişine karşı ilahi aidiyetle meşrulaşan üstün bir talep gibi okunabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **91:13.** فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا — Birincil okuma: Allah'ın elçisi, Allah'a ait deve ve onun su hakkı konusunda kavme sınır koyan bir uyarı söyler. Sürpriz ikincil okuma, bu kısa sözün bir mülkiyet ve paylaştırma bildirisi olduğunu gösterir: deve seçilmiş/yükseltilmiş bir işaret, suyu ise korunması gereken toplumsal-ekolojik paydır; söz, işaret ve kamusal haber yalanın karşısında birlikte konuşur. {ق و ل B001; ق و ل B007; ق و ل B014; ر س ل B002; ء ل ه B002; ن و ق B001; ن و ق B002; ن و ق B006; س ق ي B001; س ق ي B002; س ق ي B003}

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space becomes habitable or intelligible through construction, leveling, spreading, elevation, and stable support.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic architecture continues into mountain ridges, smooth plains, house posts, hide shelters, and the base on which property and settlement stand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ascent, Ridge, and Summit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or visible figure rises from level ground through a pass toward a ridge or summit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rising and eminence `س م و:B001/m01`; high visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`; rising and settling above `س و ي:B003/m01`; elevated moon `ط ح و:B008/m01`; high rock `ط غ و:B006/m01`; smooth high slab `ط غ ي:B005/m01`; mountain summit `ن و ق:B001/m01`; climbable long ridges `ش ق و:B004/m01` and `ش ق ي:B004/m01`; steep mountain pass `ع ق ب:B012/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Elevation is distributed across figure, motion, terrain, and endpoint. The pass and ridge make ascent a bodily route, while the summit, high slab, and raised celestial body make height a stable state of visibility and dominance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same release mechanism joins dispatch, river incision, exhalation, relief from distress, and the opening of soil for cultivation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rousing and Dispatch
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A resting participant is stirred, directed, and sent toward a task or destination.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rousing the still `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; setting out rapidly `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; release and dispatch `ر س ل:B001/m01`; successive movement `ت ل و:B001/m01`; hired carrier or cultivator `ف ل ح:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rousing converts rest into directed motion, while dispatch gives that motion a destination and function. Following then turns a single departure into an ordered sequence of participants.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same release mechanism joins dispatch, river incision, exhalation, relief from distress, and the opening of soil for cultivation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fissure, Channel, and Overflow
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pressure opens a fissure, water enters a channel, and excess rises beyond its bounds.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad opening and water eruption `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; river cutting the earth `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; widened opening `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; irrigation course `س ق ي:B003/m01`; water channels at valley ends `ذ ن ب:B004/m01`; surging overflow `ط غ و:B002/m01` and `ط غ ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel is a managed fissure: opening allows flow, a course directs it, and overflow marks the point at which directed movement escapes measure. Tail-like valley channels give the process a branching terminal geometry.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same release mechanism joins dispatch, river incision, exhalation, relief from distress, and the opening of soil for cultivation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Irrigated Ground and Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fertile ground is split, watered, covered by low growth, and brought into increase.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fertile productive soil `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; ploughing and soil-splitting `ف ل ح:B003/m01`; irrigation share `س ق ي:B003/m01`; prostrate ground-cover `ط ح و:B006/m01`; vegetal increase `ز ك و:B001/m01`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; tail-shaped plant `ذ ن ب:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cultivation coordinates soil, incision, water allotment, and growth. The plants remain close to the earth or branch into tail-like forms, making agricultural increase a visible consequence of correctly guided flow.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same release mechanism joins dispatch, river incision, exhalation, relief from distress, and the opening of soil for cultivation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Breath and Relief from Constriction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Breath, space, or assistance opens a constricted condition and restores movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: outward breath `ن ف س:B001/m01`; relief of distress `ن ف س:B002/m01`; spaciousness and respite `ن ف س:B015/m01`; easy unforced movement `ر س ل:B003/m01`; familiar ease `ر س ل:B007/m01`; widening and opening `ط ح و:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Exhalation is the bodily form of release, while respite and familiarity are its social and emotional forms. Smooth movement and widening complete a shared passage from pressure into room, ease, and renewed motion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rain Cloud and Overcast
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Clouds gather overhead, carry heavy precipitation, obscure the sun, and feed the waters below.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cloud and rain overhead `س م و:B004/m02`; layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; heavy rain-bearing cloud `س ق ي:B007/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; cloud obscuring the sun `ع ق ر:B018/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The cloud scene connects elevation to hydrology. Vapor gathers into an overhead mass, darkens the luminous field, and releases the precipitation that replenishes channels, fields, and drinking supply.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A supply exceeds immediate need and becomes sustaining water, food, multitude, wealth, or voluntary benefaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Material plenty passes into abundant milk, a body built by food, large crowds, open-handed giving, and praise spreading among people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Water, Drink, and Milk
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water or milk is made available, drawn, drunk, and retained as a life-sustaining supply.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: giving drink `س ق ي:B001/m01`; establishing a water supply `س ق ي:B002/m01`; abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; water sustaining life `ن ف س:B008/m01`; draught or drinking interval `ن ف س:B006/m01`; continuous milk yield `ر س ل:B006/m01`; full water bucket `ذ ن ب:B007/m01`; ladle `ذ ن ب:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision forms a complete handling scene: a source is established, liquid is drawn with bucket and ladle, and the drinker receives sustaining water or milk. Continuity of supply, rather than a single sip, defines the channel.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A supply exceeds immediate need and becomes sustaining water, food, multitude, wealth, or voluntary benefaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Material plenty passes into abundant milk, a body built by food, large crowds, open-handed giving, and praise spreading among people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Food Building the Body
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ingestion becomes bodily substance, growth, and renewed strength.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: swallowing and consuming `ل ه م:B001/m01`; food building flesh `ب ن ي:B010/m01`; growth and fattening `ز ك و:B001/m01`; thick syrup or nutritive paste `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; giving drink `س ق ي:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The body is treated as something constructed by intake. Swallowing admits material, food and drink supply it, and growth registers the successful conversion of nourishment into flesh and strength.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A supply exceeds immediate need and becomes sustaining water, food, multitude, wealth, or voluntary benefaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Material plenty passes into abundant milk, a body built by food, large crowds, open-handed giving, and praise spreading among people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Multitude and Material Plenty
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water, pasture, livestock, troops, or people accumulate into a conspicuous mass.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: vast crowd or army `ط ح و:B005/m01`; great quantity and scale `ل ه م:B004/m01`; gathered multitudes `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; plentiful water or pasture `ق م ر:B008/m01`; successive herds `ر س ل:B005/m01`; sudden arriving multitude `ف ج ر:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Abundance is spatial before it is evaluative: a mass spreads, gathers, or arrives in waves. Water, pasture, animals, and people share the same image of quantity becoming large enough to shape the surrounding scene.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A supply exceeds immediate need and becomes sustaining water, food, multitude, wealth, or voluntary benefaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Material plenty passes into abundant milk, a body built by food, large crowds, open-handed giving, and praise spreading among people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Generosity and Benefaction
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Internal largeness becomes willing giving, bounty, and public good repute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gushing generosity `ف ج ر:B005/m01`; generous sufficiency `ل ه م:B004/m02`; willing gift `ر س ل:B010/m02`; generous high spirit `ن ف س:B014/m02`; blessing or benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; good reputation `س م و:B008/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Giving is pictured as overflow from an ample interior. Bounty moves outward with the force of a spring, sustains others, and returns socially as a good name carried beyond the giver.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The inner person is formed through cognition, protection, purification, concealment, or corruption, and those operations issue in flourishing or failure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral interiority is rendered through concrete acts of straightening, shielding, burying, breathing, and building.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Deceptive Impulse and Divided Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An inner impulse conceals itself, fabricates a claim, and competes with reflective intention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deceitful self `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`; concealed inward impulse `د س و:B001/m01`; inwardly drawn saying `ق و ل:B006/m01`; inward intention `ن ف س:B013/m02`; desire for the precious `ن ف س:B010/m01`; protective restraint `و ق ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interior is a contested space rather than a single voice. Desire and a concealed impulse generate a private account, while intention and restraint determine whether that account remains deceptive or is brought under moral protection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Meaning moves from inner conception through an authorized speaker into utterance, response, report, attribution, and public reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Speech extends into private belief, negotiated judgment, musical responsion, rumor, and public reputation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözü sesli biçimde ortaya koyma ve ortaya konmuş sözlü ifade için genel başlık olarak uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sesle dışa vurma ve sözlü ifade çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Fiil bağlamında kişinin sözü sesli olarak ortaya koymasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Fiilsel söyleme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad bağlamında söylenmiş söz veya konuşma ürünü için uygundur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ilgili biçimi doğrudan konuşma organı olan dil diye açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu organ anlamını doğru taşır ve söylenmiş söz ya da söz sahibi anlamlarını bu dalın dışında bırakır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da gözle görülen düzensiz bir sarsılma veya titreme görünümü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi gönderme veya serbest bırakma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, elçi, rüzgar veya yağmur bir hedefe yöneltildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı harekete geçirip bir yöne yollamayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tutulan bir canlı veya denetlenen bir güç üzerindeki engel kaldırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tutmayı bırakıp serbest hareket imkanı verme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir kişi, hayvan veya topluluğun belirli bir ihtiyaç ya da hedef için görevlendirilerek yollanmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın bir hedefe doğru hareket ettirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın serbest bırakma ve doğal güçleri gönderme alanı daha geniştir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise amaçlı görevlendirmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta gönderme işlemi kurucudur; komşuda asıl vurgu hareketi engelleyen bağı kaldırmaktır.
